label: Warrior · Fury
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Dual wield Fury with two swords in Berserker Stance: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and Flurry, with Death Wish and Recklessness saved for the execute phase. It is the warrior's default Level 60 preset and its highest-DPS build.

label: Warrior · Arms · vs Dragonkin
bossText: Level 63 Dragonkin boss
summary: Arms with Spearing Strike and Improved Bloodrage against a Giant or Dragonkin boss such as Onyxia; 3.4% ahead of the generic Arms build on its own boss at 180 s.
advantage: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin. Against such a boss the talent is worth taking, so this build puts it in the rotation. The normal Arms build spends those points elsewhere.

label: Warrior · Arms
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Two-hand Arms in Battle Stance: Mortal Strike, Slam on its cooldown, Overpower off dodges and Bloodthrill procs, with Rend kept up and Weaponmaster sword procs. It is the Arms spec's Level 60 preset, about 12% behind dual wield Fury.

label: Warrior · Fury 2H
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Two-hand Fury with a Bonereaver's Edge-style sword in Berserker Stance: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Flurry and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization. The two-hand Fury variant; it trails dual wield Fury but beats Arms at 120 sec.

label: Hunter · Lone Wolf
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Marksmanship 5/41/5 with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out), played with the pet dismissed. It is the hunter's default and best Level 60 build, 10 DPS ahead of Marksmanship with a cat because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.

label: Hunter · Marksmanship
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Marksmanship 7/39/5 with a 1.0 sec cat: Efficiency 4 and Focused Fire in place of Lone Wolf. The pet deals about 14% of its damage; it is the pet alternative to Lone Wolf, 10 DPS behind.

label: Hunter · Beast Mastery
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Beast Mastery 31/20 with a 1.0 sec cat: Bestial Wrath, Frenzy, Ferocity and Unleashed Fury, plus Careful Aim and Mortal Shots in Marksmanship. The pet deals about 26% of its damage; it is the pet-focused build, 39 DPS behind Marksmanship at 180 s.

label: Hunter · Survival
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Melee Survival 7/10/34 on two one-handed swords with a cat: Predator's Edge, Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite, Strider Kick and Lacerating Strikes. It is Forever's melee hunter build; a ranged Survival build plays like Marksmanship and is only documented.

label: Paladin · Ret sub-Holy · vs Undead
bossText: Level 63 Undead boss
summary: The sub Holy twist build with Holy Conduit 2 against an Undead or Demon boss, with Exorcism and Holy Wrath in the rotation. The best paladin build on such a boss.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so against such a boss they're extra damage on top of the usual rotation. This build also takes Holy Conduit 2, which makes both spells 40% cheaper.

label: Paladin · Ret twist · vs Undead
bossText: Level 63 Undead boss
summary: The twist build retuned for an Undead or Demon boss: Purifying Power 2 for Exorcism and Holy Wrath, cast on cooldown in the twist rotation.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so against such a boss they're extra damage on top of the usual rotation. This build also takes Purifying Power 2, which makes both cooldowns a third shorter.

label: Paladin · Ret Shock · vs Undead
bossText: Level 63 Undead boss
summary: The Holy Shock build on its own vs Undead rotation, which adds Exorcism and keeps more mana for Light's Vigil in longer fights.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so against such a boss they're extra damage on top of the usual rotation. This build adds Exorcism to its Holy Shock rotation.

label: Paladin · Ret twist
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Retribution down to Twist of Light with Precision 3 from Protection and Divine Strength, Divine Intellect and Improved Seals in Holy, twisting Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness before every swing. It is the spec's default Level 60 preset and the best build at every fight length.

label: Paladin · Ret sub-Holy
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: The twist build with its side points in Holy (Divine Intellect 5, Reverence, Purifying Power) instead of Protection's Precision. It is within 0.9% of the default at every length but a different talent split, so it is its own preset on the same rotation.

label: Paladin · Ret Shock
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: A deep Holy build to Light's Vigil (Holy Shock, Holy Power 5, Consecrated Ground, Divine Precision) with Retribution to Sacred Arbiter, on Seal of Righteousness with no twisting. It is the Holy Shock playstyle, 1.2% behind twist at 180 s (level with it at 120 s).

summary: Stormstrike/Maelstrom Weapon Enhancement with a two-hand axe, Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem for the group; Concussion 5 replaces Convection 5. It is the Enhancement spec's default Level 60 preset.

label: Shaman · Enh Imp GW

bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Sub-Restoration Enhancement with Water Shield and Mana Tide Totem for the group's mana, on the Magma Totem rotation with Mana Tide at 20% mana. It is 8.7% behind Level 60 at 180 s.

label: Shaman · Elemental
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Deep Elemental caster on the synthetic Phase 1 staff set with Lava Burst, Thundering Strikes, Mindfulness and Tidal Focus, from talent searches over seven seeds. It is the Elemental spec's default Level 60 preset.

label: Shaman · Elemental Mana Tide
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: The Elemental Level 60 build with 16 Restoration points for Mana Tide Totem, cast at 20% mana for the group's mana. It is 1.0% behind Level 60 at 180 s.

label: Druid · Balance
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: 41/0/10 moonkin that keeps Insect Swarm and Moonfire up and weaves Wrath and Starfire to spend every Eclipse charge. It is the talent search's best on the synthetic Phase 1 gear and the default Balance Level 60 preset.

label: Druid · Balance Wrath
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: A second Balance playstyle with Wrath as the only filler, for a moonkin that would rather not weave; it trades Moonglow for Heart of the Wild and uses Natural Power gloves. It is 6.1% behind the default Balance build.

label: Druid · Feral
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Shred and Rip cat with Shifting Power for Energy and Berserk on cooldown, no Rake. Forever's form rules apply: the cat swings its weapon's DPS at 1.0 s, and stones, potions, Thistle Tea and Windfury Totem all work in Cat Form. It is the talent search's best on the synthetic Phase 1 gear and the default Feral Level 60 preset.

summary: Fire 29 / Frost 22 built around Frostfire Bolt, which takes both trees' talents and feeds Heating Up and Fingers of Frost at once. The mage's default Level 60 preset and the top build, the same split as foreverchanges' popular Fire build.

label: Mage · Fire

summary: Deep Fire to Combustion with Arcane Concentration and Missile Barrage from Arcane. 3% behind Frostfire.

summary: Deep Frost Frostbolt build with Fingers of Frost, Shatter and Winter's Chill, plus Arcane Concentration. Its own playstyle, 18% behind Frostfire. The preset is High Order with a Major Spellblasting Potion.

label: Warlock · Demonology
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: Demonic Pact build: the Imp is sacrificed before the pull for 15% Shadow damage and the Succubus stays out for Master Demonologist, Soul Link and Demonic Knowledge. The highest-DPS warlock build and the class default.

bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)

summary: The same Shadow points with 20 Holy points of healing utility instead of Discipline, giving up Twin Disciplines and Mental Strength. A second Shadow preset for raids that want the Holy utility, 2.5% behind Level 60 at 180 s.

label: Priest · Smite
bossText: Level 63 boss with no creature type (generic)
summary: A Holy damage priest: 31 Discipline (Power in Light, Twin Disciplines, Holy Precision, Power Infusion) and 17 Holy (Divine Fury, Searing Light) casting Smite and Holy Fire. Its own spec on its own hit-free gear, 17% behind Shadow at 180 s because Smite is a mana-hungry filler.
